snippet.title: Joymaker Gameplay Trailer - Trailer #2
snippet.description:
A closer look at the gameplay of our upcoming indie game, Joymaker.

The demo will be released for Steam Next Fest on October 1st. The demo is free so go check it out on Steam!

-Several Confused Clowns
